_readme: offhangar options. The live copy is <game folder>/offhangar_user/config.json - created from these defaults on first launch, and it survives mod updates. Options missing from the live copy fall back to the values in config_defaults.json shipped with the mod.
_experimental_features: EXPERIMENTAL toggles - may be unstable or change between versions: map_variety (0 = unlimited maps; VA/fragmentation risk on very long sessions), preload_bots (warm bot model+BSP cache during loading screen to cut spawn FPS hitch).
_modules: Module and crew crits. module_damage/crew_damage switch them off entirely, player_module_damage leaves the bots taking crits while your own tank does not. internal_module_damage covers engine/ammo bay/fuel tank/radio/turret ring and the crew: 0.8.2 ships NO collision geometry for those (the meshes only carry armour, gun, tracks, optics and the breech), so a penetrating hit rolls one reconstructed interior crit against the compartment it entered. Set false for geometry-only crits: tracks, gun, optics.
_module_test_mode: Bench for the module model. Bot shells still roll every module and crew crit with the normal era chances, but they take NO hull HP off you, a detonated ammo rack does not kill you, and fire does not drain. Lets you watch a crit happen, repair it, break it again and hear the crew line without the run ending. Turn off for normal play - you are unkillable by gunfire while it is on.
_internal_layout: internal_layout_profiles uses the per-tank interior boxes (251 vehicles) for real hit resolution instead of the reconstructed compartment model; false keeps the compartment model and never loads the profile data. internal_xray_overlay draws those boxes THROUGH the armour - a debug view for offline battles, and the module is not even imported while this is false. When true: F8 toggles it, F9 cycles view mode, F10 labels.
_physics: physics_debug=true logs a ~5 Hz telemetry row to offhangar_user/physics_telemetry.csv while driving (speed, accel, slope, grip vs gravity, turn, slide) - graph it to tune vs original WoT. physics_tuning overrides the physics constants WITHOUT recompiling (restart only). Keys: gravity_factor, cohesion, drive_traction (climb grip, ~0.75 = ~35 deg limit; raise to climb steeper), power_factor, bkwd_power_fraction, traverse_accel_time, traverse_speed_cost, coast_brake_share, steer_resist_mult, slide_max, overspeed_max_factor (downhill overspeed cap, x spec top speed), overspeed_damp (how fast overspeed bleeds back), slope_coh_decay, slope_coh_decay_y, coh_decay_bound, fall_safe_speed, fall_dmg_per_ms, ram_safe_speed. Empty = WG defaults.
_network: LAN MVP. Disabled by default. Press F11 in the offline hangar to set the server IP/port and toggle LAN mode. The server chooses the map and broadcasts it; the client value is only a fallback.
